turns.question: What was the median time in hours between an outreach message and the partner's reply, for messages sent between 1 and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: it has no reply-time or median metric, so I can't give a median time in hours between an outreach message and the partner's reply. The closest metrics are messages sent, messages replied, replies, reply rate and partners engaged, which I can compute for 1 to 3 October 2026 if you want.
